{{Quote|Before we fled, I gave the virus to some of Belsavis's most dangerous prisoners. They are the vectors, the carriers. Free them, and they will infect the Republic for us.|Doctor Fizz Galko|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A '''vault''' built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located in the [[Warlord's Deep]] in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to imprison a number of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] criminals. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Fizz Galko]] exposed several of the prisoners in the vault to his creation [[Xenovirus Prime]], but his team was forced to flee before they could release the prisoners, so Galko recruited other Imperials to free the prisoners and thus allow them to spread Xenovirus Prime to the Republic.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic prisoner vault appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Imperial mission "The Carriers of Xenovirus Prime."<ref name="TOR" />
